violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. - OBSERVED: grilled chicken (48f) was stored in Traulsen blast chiller overnight.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM discarded the grilled chicken.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: - OBSERVED: frozen salmon in intact reduced oxygen packaging (ROP) being thawed under running water in a prep sink.
violations.corrective_action: - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM instructed food employees to make a cut in each ROP package.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: THE SANITIZING STEP OF HIGH-TEMPERATURE DISHWASHER IS NOT VERIFIED. SURFACE TEMPERATURE OF PLATE SIMULATING DISHWASHER TESTER WAS 143F.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. 3-COMPARTMENT SINK WILL BE USED TO SANITIZE ALL FOOD CONTACT SURFACES.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: HIGH-TEMPERATURE DISHWASHER IS NOT SANITIZING.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. A WORK ORDER HAS BEEN PLACED.

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Written Procedures
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not prepared and stored according to written procedures: THE FACILITY PERFORMED NON-CONTINUOUS COOKING FOR GRILLED CHICKEN WITHOUT WRITTEN PROCEDURES.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be prepared and stored according to written procedures that have obtained approval from the regulatory authority, are maintained in the food establishment and are available to the regulatory authority upon request, describe hot the requirements are to be monitored and documented and corrective actions taken, describe how the foods are to be marked as foods that must be further cooked, describe how the foods are to be separated from ready-to-eat foods. CFM DISCARDED THE GRILLED CHICKEN. THE FACILITY WILL NOT PERFORM NON-CONTINUOUS COOKING IN FUTURE.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED LIVE FRUIT FLIES AT MOP SINK AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT PEST CONTROL SERVICE AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.
